songLineChanges.songLine: Infantile Material, the oldest stuff lies deepest; still four years old, want that cookie.
songLineChanges.reason: four years old sung rather than numeral

songLineChanges.songLine: Seven sharp: The Alarm Clock, executioner of the dream; the return of cruel cold logic of seven A.M.
songLineChanges.reason: seven A.M. sung rather than digital time

songLineChanges.songLine: The Interpretation Detective, Royal Road to Unconscious, bad intentions and dirty jokes.
